The scriptures reinforce this with Psalm 65:7 (stilling the sea's noise) and Mark 4:39 (Christ rebuking the storm ).

The book's focus on nations in turmoil refines this by narrowing the referent to political chaos stilled by Christ, while preserving the broader category of divine power over turmoil.
